Sharjeel Imam's interim bail not cancelled despite media contact

A Delhi court did not cancel the interim bail of Sharjeel Imam, who was accused of violating bail conditions by contacting the media. The court acknowledged that Imam's appearance in a video related to media contact constituted a breach of his bail terms. However, because he had already departed to surrender, the court decided against revoking his bail. Imam was reportedly heading to Delhi when police raised questions in court about his actions.
